design: A menacing cursed medieval knight in full charcoal-black steel plate with tarnished silver edging, one restrained emerald rune on breastplate, a closed angular visor with thin green eye slits, jagged small helmet crest and a tattered dark-maroon cape. Heavy gauntlets and boots, exact same armor all16poses. Holds ONE SHORT broad dark iron longsword in BOTH hands across waist, visibly retained during hurt and dodge. No shield, no floating green flames or particles. Stylized polished painted fantasy villain matching player knights, imposing comic menace rather than realistic horror or cute. Idle planted armored stance and subtle settling/eye flicker; hurt recoils and braces with sword close; attack raises sword then slashes toward RIGHT, recovery; dodge ducks/leans backward and returns. Full blade/cape/helmet inside spacious cells, no cropping.
prompt: Re-layout this exact transparent 4x4 sheet with more space: uniformly make every knight pose 25% SMALLER, centered in its own equal cell with wide transparent margins. Preserve all sixteen poses, dark armor, maroon cape, green visor and the same sword held in both hands throughout. Specifically ROW THREE COLUMN THREE's extended sword must end well BEFORE the next knight in column four, never touching its cape or armor. All silhouettes completely separate; all swords and capes fully visible. Same identity and uniform body scale across16poses, real transparent background, no text or effects.
